name: Michigan county-seat bicycle route
description: The 83 county seats in the driving map's visit order, using bicycle routing and one vehicle transfer over the Mackinac Bridge. Time estimates exclude stops and shuttle waiting. Some bicycle legs include short dismount sections. Pins are address geocodes. Edge endpoints are snapped to the mapped transportation network.
attribution: Road network and some coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Other coordinate sources are linked per stop.
